node.statement: Right approximate inverse law. Product closeness gives ||mu(U,sigma(U))-U bold-dot sigma(U)||<=G_c*e. By inverse closeness and 1.5, ||U bold-dot sigma(U)-U bold-dot U^dagger||<2G_c*e, while 1.5 gives ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<2e. Hence ||mu(U,sigma(U))-J||<(3G_c+2)e<=C_grp*e, since C_grp>=8G_c and C_grp>=8.
